CEH Loss of Excitation Relay - Legacy

heading: CEH Loss of Excitation Relay - Legacy

text: Manufacturing for CEH has been discontinued. As an alternative, please refer to P342 or 889 or G30.
heading: CEH Loss of Excitation Relay - Legacy

text: The type CEH relays are used for the detection of the loss of excitation of synchronous generators, and to automatically remove the generator from service. Loss of excitation can be damaging to the machine, and/or detrimental to the operation of the system. It is recommended that loss-of- excitation protection be considered for all synchronous generators.
